_note: Arms and judges. Pick with --engine <name|group|all>; with no --engine, every engine with enabled not false runs. Keys come from .secrets.env or the environment, by name only. Prices are US dollars per million tokens; null means unknown, and the report then shows n/a. Anything marked TO CONFIRM is checked with `models` and `check` before run 1.

opus._why: the field comparison's model and the falsifier 3 engine (spikes.md). Effort set to medium by Angelotxx271 on 2026-11-25 (also the API default); adaptive thinking (can't be turned off on this model); no sampling settings

sonnet._why: the cheaper Claude, added by Angelotxx271 on 2026-11-24 (protocol v2 amendment 1). API defaults: adaptive thinking, effort high

glm._why: Z.ai GLM 5.3 served by Mistral's API; zai-glm-5-3 confirmed on 2026-11-25 from GET /v1/models. Price: from the Mistral console

mistral._why: Mistral Large 4, pinned on 2026-11-25 from GET /v1/models (mistral-large-latest and mistral-large-4-0 are aliases of it). Price: not on Mistral's public page per model; take it from the console and fill it in

qwen-local._why: the protocol's local Qwen on the owner's PC (RTX 5070, 12 GB). A mixture of experts with about 3B active parameters, so it runs at a usable speed with part of it in system memory. Thinking on (the model's default): on a C2-sized prompt it thought for over 6,000 tokens, so answers get up to 32k. num_ctx leaves room for C2 (about 45k tokens by Qwen's count) plus a long answer; a prompt that might not fit is refused, never cut

qwen38-local._why: the newest Qwen, 27B; about 18 GB, so on a 12 GB card a large part runs from system memory and it is several times slower. Off unless the team picks it over qwen-local

local-openai._why: any other OpenAI-compatible local server (vLLM, llama.cpp). Its context window is set on the server and can't be checked from here: give it at least 64k

opus-cli._why: protocol v2's original route: the Claude Code CLI on the owner's subscription. Needs a CLI with --safe-mode and --system-prompt-file (claude update). Its thinking and effort follow Claude Code's settings, not the API defaults

haiku._why: optional: cheapest Claude, for the cost benchmark. Cache prices assume the usual 0.1x read and 1.25x write

judge-sonnet._why: first-pass blind judge (spikes.md); the two human scorers confirm. Sonnet is also an arm, so the judge-vs-people agreement is read per engine

judge-sonnet-cli._why: the same judge through the Claude Code CLI on the subscription
